conviction_note: Event confirmed by the company's own 2026-08-18 notice (results 2026-10-16); the period is a pre-guided REIT half with no pre-release, so the print turns on a possible buyback (done at the Oct-2024 print, +2.18% next day; peers GLP/Prologis/SOSiLA buying back now) against higher refinancing costs feeding the Feb-2027/Aug-2027 forecasts. Both are inference, they roughly offset, so p_up 52 on an abs move of 1.1 gives +0.04, while the per-finding sum is +0.25 because the buyback upside is sized on its own.

findings.finding: NMF has a precedent of announcing a 自己投資口取得 with its October results (2024-10-17, 21,080 units bought 2024-10-18 to 12-05; also July 2024), the unit price is now 134,600 against 142,500 at that 2024 print, and Aug-FP peer GLP REIT announced a JPY10bn (1.62%) buyback with its results on 2026-10-15, so a buyback at this print is plausible but not disclosed.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 2024-10-17 results + buyback: +2.18% close-to-close (142,500 -> 145,600), the largest of the last six print reactions (Yahoo chart https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/3462.T?range=3y&interval=1d). Peer GLP REIT on 2026-10-16 morning: +0.47% vs J-REIT ETF 1343 -0.1% after its buyback.
findings.why_not_priced: Nothing has been announced; with no options and zero disclosed shorts there is no instrument expressing the probability, and the unit has drifted down with the sector (-6.3% over 20 sessions, J-REIT ETF 1343 similar) rather than firming into the print as it would if a buyback were anticipated.
findings.independence: GLP REIT buyback notice 2026-10-15 https://www.release.tdnet.info/inbs/140120261015551466.pdf; NMF's own record of 2024 buybacks and cancellations in the 2026-02 短信 notes 11-12 https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260417/140120260417505962.pdf (same company, different document).

findings.finding: Refinancing in August 2026 was done at a 7-year fixed 2.83565% (MUFG, JPY2.5bn) and floating 1M/3M TIBOR + 0.17-0.26% on JPY23.6bn, after the BOJ's June hike to 1.0%, while the April forecast for FP Feb-2027 assumed JPY3,165m of interest costs with JPY40.1bn more to refinance in that period; earnings for Feb-2027 and the new Aug-2027 forecast face upward interest pressure that ATA/excess distributions (already 824 yen in the Feb-2027 DPU) would have to absorb.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 2025-10-16 print (headline '今期経常は17%減益へ', DPU held with excess distributions): -0.73%; 2026-04-17 print (guide raised to 3,695 via sale gains): -1.03%. Guidance prints have produced small negatives.
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced: the rate rise is public and the sector is down ~19% YTD. What is not priced is how much of it NMF passes into the DPU forecast rather than absorbing with ATA; the unit trades at a ~5.5% yield on the 3,695/3,719 forecasts, which would be visibly higher if a DPU cut were expected.
findings.independence: Loan notice 2026-08-14 (spreads, floating structure) https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260814/140120260814520996.pdf — same financing, so counted once; macro context (BOJ hike to 1.0% in June, JGB 10y >2.5%) from search snippets only.

findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No separate reaction recorded; the 2026-08-18 acquisition announcement day is not distinguishable from sector moves.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced (public since 2026-08-18 with NOI disclosed); roughly +40 yen/unit per half on ~4.65m units before costs, within normal forecast noise.
